title: faro.sampling.rules/v1
description: A Faro adaptive sampling rules document. Passed to the SDK as data (sessionTracking.sampling). Rules without a trigger are evaluated in document order at the decision point and the first whose scope matches decides (drop, or a base rate); rules with a trigger are unordered and keep a session because of something that happened in it. Keeps only widen; nothing un-keeps.

schema.description: Document version. An unknown value makes the SDK warn and keep everything.

rules.description: Order matters for rules without a trigger: first match decides.

globMap.description: Field or attribute path to glob. `*` is the only wildcard and matches any run of characters, including none; the pattern must match the whole value. Every listed entry must match.

type.description: A trigger type from the platform's catalogue. Unknown types make the rule inert with a warning, not an error, so the schema does not enumerate them. Web, v1: error, custom_event, page_view, user_action, web_vital_threshold, http_error, console_error, attribute. Reserved: journey.

match.description: Globs on the event's fields. Absent means any event of this type. For web_vital_threshold, `threshold` is compared as a number (fires at or above) instead of as a glob.

id.description: Author-chosen, unique in the document, stable across edits and reorders. Reported as keptByRule in the verdict.

trigger.description: Absent or null means a rule without a trigger.

scope.description: Attribute paths (session.attributes.<key>, app.version, browser.name, ...) to globs. Absent or {} means every session. Matched once at the decision point and frozen.

baseRate.description: Keep rules without a trigger only, and required there. Probability a matching session is in the base sample. 0 means triggers only for this scope.

replayRate.description: keep_session_and_replay rules without a trigger only. Share of base-sampled sessions that also record replay. Default 1.

triggerRate.description: Trigger rules only. When the trigger fires, the fraction of sessions actually kept by it. Default 1.

allOf.$comment: Rules without a trigger: no triggerRate.
Exclusion: no trigger, drop. Carries nothing else.
Base rate: no trigger, keep action. baseRate required; replayRate only with keep_session_and_replay.
Trigger: keep action only (a triggered drop would un-keep a session that is already streaming and billed), no baseRate, no replayRate.

untriggered.$comment: True when the rule has no trigger: the field is absent or null.
